mental_plane.complete: With the Mental Plane (4-9-2) complete, you possess a sharp intellect, clear thoughts, and excellent reasoning abilities.
mental_plane.incomplete: With an incomplete Mental Plane (4-9-2), you may sometimes struggle with scattered thoughts or find it challenging to focus.

emotional_plane.complete: The Emotional Plane (3-5-7) is complete, indicating a rich emotional life, strong intuition, and deep compassion for others.
emotional_plane.incomplete: An incomplete Emotional Plane (3-5-7) suggests that you might be learning to navigate your feelings and develop deeper emotional expression.

practical_plane.complete: Your complete Practical Plane (8-1-6) shows that you are grounded, reliable, and skilled at managing the material aspects of life.
practical_plane.incomplete: An incomplete Practical Plane (8-1-6) can mean you are less concerned with material details and may need to focus on organization.

thought_plane.complete: The Thought Plane (4-3-8) is complete, giving you a methodical mind and the ability to think through plans from conception to execution.
thought_plane.incomplete: An incomplete Thought Plane (4-3-8) may indicate a tendency to be more spontaneous and less focused on detailed planning.

will_plane.complete: With a complete Will Plane (9-5-1), you have strong determination, ambition, and the persistence to achieve your goals.
will_plane.incomplete: An incomplete Will Plane (9-5-1) suggests that you may sometimes need to bolster your self-confidence and follow through on your intentions.

action_plane.complete: Your complete Action Plane (2-7-6) endows you with a dynamic, hands-on approach to life. You are a doer who makes things happen.
action_plane.incomplete: An incomplete Action Plane (2-7-6) can point to a preference for thinking and planning over direct physical action.

silver_success_plane.complete: The Silver Success Plane (4-5-6) is complete, indicating financial awareness and the ability to build security through careful planning.
silver_success_plane.incomplete: An incomplete Silver Success Plane (4-5-6) suggests that financial matters may not be your top priority, requiring more conscious effort.

golden_success_plane.complete: With the Golden Success Plane (2-5-8) complete, you have a natural ability to attract prosperity and success in your endeavors.
golden_success_plane.incomplete: An incomplete Golden Success Plane (2-5-8) may mean that achieving success requires overcoming specific challenges and learning important lessons.
